messages:
maggie: Need a short, operational runbook for price ceilings + exceptions to drop into the roadmap. Board wants a single-page rule set. Can we agree on SLAs and automated guardrails today?

anya: Proposal: public price ceiling for Hosted + listed addons. Exceptions allowed only for Dedicated/Private and must follow the runbook: request -> RevOps review -> Legal amendment -> signoff. Target SLA: 48h for RevOps review on standard requests.

rebekah: Add an automated guardrail: billing should auto-reject requests that would create >25% margin erosion unless Exec signoff attached. That prevents surprise losses.

owen: Tech constraints: we need a billing flag fields set: list_price, requested_price, approved_price, approver, approval_ts, approval_ticket. Console should show a banner and an audit view. Also need an API to surface pending approvals to Sales.

revops-bot: RevOps: we'll accept 48h review SLA for normal requests. For expedited procurement we allow a 4h pre-approval flow if it's under $10k ARR and AE+RevOps confirm in-thread. We'll log expedited as "expedited" in the ticket.

legal-bot: Legal: exceptions require a signed amendment for deals > $50k ARR. For smaller deals, an approval ticket + email confirmation is sufficient. We'll prepare two amendment templates and an expedited clause for procurement.

maggie: Grandfathering & sunset: recommend 120 days notice for published price increases; addon sunsets = 120d for enterprise, 30d for self-serve. For negotiated exceptions, changes follow the amendment terms.

anya: Add telemetry: override_rate (pct of deals with approved exceptions), avg_discount_pct, mean_time_to_approve, and margin_delta_per_tenant. RevOps dashboard tile please.

rebekah: Also add a safety automation: if margin_delta_per_tenant > 20% and no exec signoff within 24h, auto-suspend new overage billing for that tenant and notify sales + finance. Manual unblock flow required.

owen: We'll need two infra tickets: (1) billing schema + approval API, (2) Console audit view + banner + pending approvals list. ETA estimates in tickets.

revops-bot: created ticket #9802 "Exception runbook: approval SLA, automation, telemetry" assignees: anya, rebekah, owen. ETA 2025-06-01.

sales-bot: created ticket #9803 "Sales enablement: exception runbook one-pager + approval playbook" assignees: sales-eng. ETA 2025-05-28.

maggie: Good. Owners: anya -> runbook doc + SLA page, rebekah -> automation rules + margin thresholds, owen -> infra tickets, legal-bot -> amendment templates, revops-bot -> dashboard. I'll draft the roadmap paragraph and link these tickets; merging today unless objections.

anya: No objections.

rebekah: LGTM.

owen: fine by eng.

legal-bot: OK from legal side; will attach templates.
